name: The Grotto of Depravity
summary: The Grotto of Depravity is a cave in southern Coldharbour, southwest of the Hollow City containing Daedra. Nerazakan can be found in the upper chamber to the east. The Daedra inside are in a constant state of partying, while soul-shriven minstrels and dancers are forced to provide entertainment for them. Centipedes and frogs are found in numbers within.
